# RaceFeed

> RaceFeed is a free suite of cycling tools for road cyclists, mountain bikers, and triathletes: a unified race calendar plus interactive calculators for gearing, nutrition, and bike fit.

## Tools

- [Cycling Race Calendar](https://racefeed.com.br/events/): Unified calendar of cycling and MTB events and races.
- [Cycling Power, Gear Ratio & FTP Calculator](https://racefeed.com.br/tools/cycling-power-calculator/): Visualize gear ratios, crank length, gain ratio, FTP power zones, and speed vs power for any terrain.
- [Cycling Nutrition Calculator](https://racefeed.com.br/tools/cycling-nutrition-calculator/): Estimate carbs per hour from ride duration, intensity and weight, with a practical fuelling plan.
- [Cycling Hydration Calculator](https://racefeed.com.br/tools/cycling-hydration-calculator/): Estimate sweat rate, water and sodium needs per hour, with a bottle and electrolyte plan.
- [Race Day Fuel Plan](https://racefeed.com.br/tools/race-day-fuel-plan/): Combine carbs, water and sodium into one ready-to-pack race-day fuelling plan.
- [Gear Range Calculator](https://racefeed.com.br/tools/gear-range-calculator/): Drivetrain visualizer showing every cassette and chainring combination on a speed/development axis; compare two drivetrains side by side.
- [Stem Comparison Tool](https://racefeed.com.br/tools/stem-comparison/): Compare bicycle stem dimensions side by side; visualize reach and rise for any stem length and angle.

## Blog

- [Tech Blog](https://racefeed.com.br/blog/en/): Notes on building RaceFeed — Django, data pipelines, indie hacking, and cycling tech.
